luck.processing: AI high-resolution reconstruction based on the classic inventory icon; transparent editorial illustration, not a client-model render.
luck.prompt: Edit this MU Online Talisman of Luck inventory icon into a crisp high-resolution faithful reconstruction for the MU PANIC Atlas. Preserve the EXACT silhouette and component arrangement of the reference: four-lobed dark emerald clover within an antique gold rim, same front-facing orientation, single object centered, generous transparent margin. Remove pixel stair-stepping and compression blur; reconstruct fine metallic bevel detail and crystal edges. It must remain the same recognizable game item. No new silhouette, no extra lobes, no extra jewels, no letters, no text, no border, no background, no shadows outside the object. Square high resolution with genuine transparent alpha. Faithful high resolution editorial illustration of the inventory icon, not a new design.
